title: Implement application-send turn shadow policy evidence
summary: Add a bounded application-send turn observation, deterministic shadow recommendation, axis-specific provenance export, replay, and force-legacy rollback without changing applied scheduler behavior.
planned_changes: Introduce compact immutable send-turn observation, recommendation, state, reason, and provenance types; add bounded connection-local counters only where the observation schema requires them; evaluate and publish only at the existing actor-turn planning boundary; keep the scheduler on legacy_current; retain forced construction provenance and observe-only/shadow raw-host records as separate versioned streams; extend permanent result export and deterministic replay without relabeling receive-credit epochs; and add an independent force-legacy rollback path.
verification_plan: Build before testing. Add requirement-home tests for disabled, observe-only, shadow, every forced value, force-legacy rollback, safe-boundary latching, reason precedence, missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, and out-of-domain inputs, cancellation, disposal, FIN, reset, shutdown, recovery, congestion, pacing, flow-control, queue, and buffer guards. Add bounded property sequences and focused mechanism benchmarks outside correctness CI. Run the complete correctness-only Release suite, then local permanent neutrality and shadow campaigns before any reviewed multi-host campaign.
out_of_scope: Online learning, exploration, bandits, or runtime model training
Application-send batch formation, queued-send burst budget, oversized-write admission, actor quantum, packet cadence, placement, or protocol-sensitive axes
Reclassification, deletion, or relabeling of retained negative or excluded evidence
